claims.text: Push changes to Lynx
claims.note: The toolbar button is CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_CHANGES "Push Changes" and the dialog footer is STRINGS.PUSH_N_CHANGES_TO_LYNX "Push {{num}} changes to Lynx".

claims.text: Review, deselect, send and verify.
claims.note: Review is the dialog table, deselect is the per-row checkbox, send is the footer button, and verify is the automatic read-back comparison in the push service.

claims.text: Review every pending adjustment, drop the ones you do not want, and send the rest to the controller.
claims.note: The pending list is every enabled station whose % Adj. differs from what Lynx holds (sa-dashboard.component.ts:659-662). Rows can be unticked, and only the ticked rows are sent. The pending list also contains stations already pushed today, which arrive unticked (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:23-24). "The controller" is read as Lynx Central Control: the push writes each station's percent adjust to Lynx (lynx-cloud.service.ts:80-95). Reaching the field also needs the push-then-synchronise step that 373-1135 rev 02 §Push Changes Dialog Box, p.10 requires, as recorded by feature 5 in docs/claims/operational-contract.md (OC-3, OC-4). That step is feature 5's operational-contract wording, not a fault in this sentence.

claims.text: Toolbar › Push Changes
claims.note: The Push Changes button is the first control in the toolbar's right-hand group (#sa-tb-right).

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: The route is /spatialadjust. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The guide starts on the dashboard with no dialog open; every dialog here opens only on a user action. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: Lynx must be reachable, and Site Adjust and Course Adjust must both be 100% in Lynx.
claims.note: Lynx must be reachable, and Site Adjust and Course Adjust must be 100% in Lynx. Reworded from push-to-lynx/before/4, push-to-lynx/before/1.

claims.text: Lynx must be reachable.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. The source settles it without 373-1135: every write goes through the Lynx Cloud or Lynx Drive service (lynx-proxy.service.ts:148-150), and when Lynx stops answering the product says so in its own copy, SPATIAL_ADJUST.CONNECTION_LOST_MSG "Connection to Lynx lost. Unable to retrieve or update Percent Adjust values. Please ensure Lynx is online and try again." This is the IntelliDash-to-Lynx connection, not a Lynx-side setting.

claims.text: If the connection is lost an amber banner appears above the toolbar and percent adjust values cannot be read or written.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. The banner is .sa-top-banner, drawn before the toolbar in spatial-adjust-main.component.html, with background #f59e0b (amber). It is raised when the 30-second heartbeat ping fails (sa-dashboard.component.ts:827-841) and cleared when a ping succeeds. Its text is SPATIAL_ADJUST.CONNECTION_LOST_MSG, which says Percent Adjust values can be neither retrieved nor updated.

claims.text: Stations already pushed today are listed separately and arrive unselected, so you do not adjust the same station twice.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. Stations whose last push falls on the current course-local day go into a separate Pushed Today list and are unticked on load. The dialog's own banner, SPECIAL_MSG.PUSH_STATION_CHANGES, gives the same reason: "to prevent double adjustments". Wording changed after expert feedback in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review.

claims.text: In Lynx, Site Adjust and Course Adjust must both be 100%.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 sets the site Adjust field and the Course Adjust field in Lynx to 100%. Lynx-side setting, outside IntelliDash.

claims.text: Any other value is applied on top of every percentage you push, so the whole course waters more or less than the dashboard shows, and nothing reports an error.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 gives the required value, not the consequence of another one. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q5: if Site Adjust or Course Adjust is not 100%, does Lynx multiply it into every station percentage Spatial Adjust pushes, so that a Course Adjust of 80% turns a pushed 120% into 96%? With more than one Lynx course, must Course Adjust be 100% on every course pushed to?

claims.text: In the Lynx watering plan, Pct. Adjust must be 100 on the program and on every hole under it that you have enabled in Spatial Adjust, for example Fairways and 2-Fairways.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 sets Pct. Adjust to 100 on the Fairways program and on its 2-Fairways hole. Lynx-side setting, outside IntelliDash.
claims.previousText: In the Lynx watering plan, Pct.

claims.text: Any other value is applied on top of the percentages you push to the stations under it, again without an error.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 gives the required value, not the consequence of another one. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q6: if the program's or a hole's Pct. Adjust is not 100, does Lynx multiply it into the pushed percentage of every station under it, in the same way as Course Adjust?

claims.text: In the same program, Next Amt. must equal the Lynx Reference Amount under Settings › Calculation, in the same units.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 sets the program's Next Amt. equal to the Lynx Reference Amount, and p.12 says to set both amounts in the chosen units. Lynx Reference Amount is a field on the Calculation tab of Settings at production.

claims.text: Every suggestion is a percentage of that reference amount, so a mismatch scales what each station receives by the ratio between the two, again without an error.
claims.note: The first clause is settled: for both methods the suggestion is the applied amount divided by the Lynx Reference Amount (SpatialAdjustLogic.cs:81, :125-130), as 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 works the Daily Max example (10 mm ÷ 5 mm = 200%). What Lynx does with the percentage is not in the document. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q7: does Lynx apply a station's pushed percentage to the program's Next Amt.? If so, a Next Amt. that differs from the Lynx Reference Amount scales what every station receives by Next Amt. ÷ Lynx Reference Amount.

claims.text: Check the pending count
claims.note: The pending count is carried in the button label itself, CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_N_CHANGES "Push {{ num }} Changes".

claims.text: Find [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar and read the number on it.
claims.note: Push Changes is on the toolbar and carries the count. Reworded from push-to-lynx/where/1, push-to-lynx/1/2.

claims.text: The button shows a count, such as Push 6 Changes, and the green counter beside it shows how many went out today.
claims.note: The button reads Push N Changes and the green counter beside it counts today's pushes. Reworded from push-to-lynx/1/3, push-to-lynx/1/5, push-to-lynx/1/2.

claims.text: If [[Push Changes]] is grayed out, nothing is waiting or a push is still running.
claims.note: The button is disabled when nothing is queued or a push is running. Reworded from push-to-lynx/1/4, push-to-lynx/verify/2. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Wait for the push to finish, then look again.
claims.note: The button re-enables after the push. Reworded from push-to-lynx/1/4.

claims.text: Six changes pending, six already pushed today.
claims.note: Figure caption. The toolbar shows both numbers: the pending count in the button label and the pushed-today count in the green counter.

claims.text: Review the two lists
claims.note: The two lists are CASE_SENSITIVE.N_AVAIL_TO_PUSH "{{num}} Available to Push" and CASE_SENSITIVE.N_PUSHED_TODAY "{{num}} Pushed Today".

claims.text: Select [[Push Changes]].
claims.note: Push Changes opens the dialog. Reworded from push-to-lynx/tile/1, push-to-lynx/where/1.

claims.text: The [[Push Changes]] dialog lists Available to Push first, all ticked, then [[Pushed Today]], unticked.
claims.note: Available to Push first, ticked; Pushed Today second, unticked. Reworded from push-to-lynx/2/3.

claims.text: If nothing opens, [[Push Changes]] is grayed out because nothing is waiting.
claims.note: The button is disabled when nothing is queued. Reworded from push-to-lynx/1/4. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Tick a [[Pushed Today]] row only if you mean to adjust that station a second time today.
claims.note: A pushed station is ticked only on purpose. Reworded from push-to-lynx/2/4.

claims.text: Push dialog.
claims.note: Figure caption. The dialog header is CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_CHANGES, title-cased, which reads "Push Changes".

claims.text: Current on the left, the proposed change on the right.
claims.note: Figure caption. Same evidence as push-to-lynx/2/2.

claims.text: Look for threshold adjustments
claims.note: Threshold adjustments are flagged per station in the toolbar (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:433-460) and summarised in the dialog banner.

claims.text: Find the pink banner above the lists, with the [[Review Threshold]] link at its right.
claims.note: The banner has a Review Threshold link. Reworded from push-to-lynx/3/2, push-to-lynx/3/3.

claims.text: The banner counts the stations the threshold changed, and each row shows Adjusted to and the value that will be sent.
claims.note: The banner counts the stations altered; each row shows Adjusted to. Reworded from push-to-lynx/3/2.

claims.text: If there is no banner, the threshold changed no station or is set to 0, so there is nothing to check.
claims.note: No banner means the threshold changed no station or is 0. Reworded from push-to-lynx/3/2, push-to-lynx/3/4.

claims.text: [[Review Threshold]] closes this dialog and opens [[Settings]] without sending anything.
claims.note: Review Threshold closes this dialog and opens Settings. Reworded from push-to-lynx/3/3.

claims.text: Two stations were adjusted by the minimum threshold before sending.
claims.note: Figure caption. The substitution happens at send time: the threshold value replaces the proposed value for every ticked row that carries an override (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:74-79).

claims.text: Untick anything you are not sure about
claims.note: Every row in both lists has its own checkbox.

claims.text: In the [[Changes]] column, untick each station you do not want to send.
claims.note: Each row in the Changes column has its own tick box. Reworded from push-to-lynx/4/1, push-to-lynx/2/6.

claims.text: The count on the footer button drops by 1 for each row you untick.
claims.note: The footer count equals the ticked rows. Reworded from push-to-lynx/4/2, push-to-lynx/4/4.

claims.text: If [[Pushed Today]] rows became ticked, you used the box beside [[Changes]] in the heading, which ticks both lists.
claims.note: The box beside Changes in the heading is a tri-state box that ticks or unticks every row of both lists (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:53-58; sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:89-97). Reworded from push-to-lynx/2/3.

claims.text: Untick the rows you did not mean.
claims.note: Unticking removes the row from the push. Reworded from push-to-lynx/4/1.

claims.text: Unticking is not reverting: the station keeps its value in the table and is offered again next time.
claims.note: Unticking does not revert the edit. Reworded from push-to-lynx/4/3.

claims.text: The footer button always names the number of changes that will be sent.
claims.note: Figure caption. STRINGS.PUSH_N_CHANGES_TO_LYNX "Push {{num}} changes to Lynx", with num set to the number of ticked rows.

claims.text: Send and watch the progress
claims.note: Sending opens the "Pushing Changes To Lynx" progress dialog with a progress bar and a status line.

claims.text: Select the footer button of the [[Push Changes]] dialog, such as Push 6 changes to Lynx.
claims.note: The footer button reads Push N changes to Lynx (en-us.json:907; sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:144). Reworded from push-to-lynx/4/4, push-to-lynx/tile/1.

claims.text: A progress window counts the stations as they are written to Lynx.
claims.note: The progress window counts stations as they are written (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:121-153). Reworded from push-to-lynx/5/1, push-to-lynx/5/4.

claims.text: If the bar drops back to 0 near the end, a retry has begun for the stations that failed.
claims.note: The retry starts a new count that restarts at zero. Reworded from push-to-lynx/5/3, verify-results/4/4.

claims.text: Let it run.
claims.note: The run needs no input. Reworded from push-to-lynx/5/1.

claims.text: Spatial Adjust writes each station, reads Lynx back to check it, and retries any that do not match.
claims.note: Write, read back, compare, then retry any that did not match, up to two more attempts. Reworded from push-to-lynx/5/2, verify-results/4/2.

claims.text: Push in progress, station four of six.
claims.note: Figure caption. SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_PUSHING "Pushing Percent Adjustments to Lynx ({{index}} of {{count}})".

claims.text: Push window. Push between 11 AM and the synchronization time set in Lynx, and synchronize Lynx after the push.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.10 gives the window, 11 AM to the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and says to synchronise after the push. It names no time zone and does not say how to synchronise. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing). Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.
claims.question: Q1 and Q2 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md): is the 11 AM in the course's local time or US Eastern Time, and does the synchronisation Lynx runs at its scheduled time pick up an earlier push, or must the superintendent synchronise Lynx by hand after every push?

claims.text: Outside that window the push does not reach the course, and no error tells you so.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 gives the window but never says what happens outside it, and IntelliDash has no push-window logic. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q3 and Q4: does a push made after the Lynx synchronisation time, or before 11 AM, fail to reach the course, and does anything in Spatial Adjust or Lynx report it? (The push dialog would still verify the values against Lynx and report success.)

claims.text: Confirm the result
claims.note: When processing completes, the dialog swaps the progress bar for a result line and a Close button.

claims.text: Read the result line above [[Close]].
claims.note: The result line sits above the Close button (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:155-164). Reworded from push-to-lynx/6/1.

claims.text: It reads [[All selected changes successfully pushed to Lynx.]]
claims.note: The success line is LYNX_PUSH_SUCCESS (en-us.json:418). Reworded from push-to-lynx/6/5, push-to-lynx/6/2.

claims.text: If it names stations that could not be updated, check the connection to Lynx, then follow Push failures.
claims.note: A failure names the stations that could not be updated. Reworded from push-to-lynx/6/4, push-to-lynx/6/3.

claims.text: All selected changes pushed successfully.
claims.note: Figure caption. SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_SUCCESS "All selected changes successfully pushed to Lynx."

claims.text: Push Changes no longer counts the stations you sent.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (push-to-lynx/verify/1); docs/text-corrections.md §16 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: The green pushed-today counter increased by the number you sent.
claims.note: After the push stamps the sent stations (sa-push-changes.service.ts:174-179), the pending list is rebuilt and the counter is re-fetched (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:163). The counter counts each station once per course-local day, so it grows by the number sent unless some of them were already in Pushed Today. A re-push of those adds nothing. Stations that failed are counted as well.

claims.text: Rows you pushed successfully no longer show a push icon.

claims.text: A row that still shows the pushed-today icon was sent, but Lynx does not hold the value shown in the table.
